notes: PCB cost: $32.20 4-layer minimum price + $29.84 ENIG + $94.73 for all vias filled with resin and capped = $156.77. The fab notes require that via process because 82 vias sit in or touch SMD pads; tented it would be $62.04. PCBWay's 'Via in pad' option prices the same. Fab notes allow 0.5 oz or 1 oz inner copper, quoted as 1 oz. Solder mask is any colour, quoted green. No impedance control is asked for. Assembly, top side only: J5/J6 header holes and FID1-FID3 aren't placed, leaving 82 SMD parts on 38 BOM lines. Normal price = max($88, $25.27 + $0.1523 x 82 x qty), so $88 for 1 and 5 boards. It meets every $29 promo limit at both quantities (0 THT joints, 38 unique, 410 parts). Struck-through 'list' prices next to $29: $243.18 (qty 1) and $247.24 (qty 5), from the qty >= 11 formula, not charged here.
